The DSH agent investigates"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" this machine's disk waste with Pare's read-only tools and prepares a cleanup. The scanning, investi"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"gation and cleanup are all done by the separate Pare core; the plugin only starts the core, register"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"s the tools and asks for approval."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Nothing changes until you approve it in DSH's own approval prompt, and files are moved into a revers"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ible quarantine rather than deleted."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Recorded in a real DSH session on a demo folder."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Restart the profile (for example `dsh web`). On first start the plugin d"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ownloads the pinned Pare core and verifies it (see The pinned core)."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## A closer look"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Approval — the prompt lists the exact files before anything moves."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Result — the agent's report after the cleanup, with what was kept and why."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The plugin starts a long-lived `pare serve` process (protocol `pare.serve/1`, line-delimited JSON ov"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"er stdio) and registers these tools. The scan index lives in that process, so run `pare_scan` before"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" the investigation tools."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Tool | What it does | Needs approval |
|---|---|:---:|
| `pare_scan` | Read-only scan of a drive o"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"r folder; keeps the index in the core process | No |
| `pare_scan_overview`, `pare_list_dir`, `pare_"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"find_large_files`, `pare_same_size_files`, `pare_breakdown`, `pare_file_head`, `pare_read_text`, `pa"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"re_path_info`, `pare_installed_programs`, `pare_running_processes`, `pare_run_diagnostic` | Read-onl"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"y investigation tools provided by the core. The list is requested from the core at startup (`hello`)"},{"id":"p14s6","text":" and follows the core version | No |
| `pare_read_sensitive` | Reads files Pare marks as sensitive ("},{"id":"p14s7","text":"keys, `.env`, browser login data, credential stores) | Yes, every time |
| `pare_prepare_cleanup` | "},{"id":"p14s8","text":"Registers paths for quarantine and supported action templates, and returns a cleanup id. Nothing cha"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"nges yet | No |
| `pare_execute` | Executes a prepared cleanup by id | Yes |

DSH's own bash tool has its own approval."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Approval and safety"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The plugin listens to DSH's `tools/pre-execute` and answers `{kind: 'ask'}` for `pare_execute`, `par"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"e_undo`, `pare_purge` and `pare_read_sensitive`. DSH asks you through its own approval service. Only"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" a one-time `allowed-once` lets the call through; if you reject, cancel, or nobody is available to a"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"nswer, the call is denied (fail closed). Every question is recorded in the session audit log."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- The approval prompt for `pare_execute` is built from the plan the plugin stored, listing the exact"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" paths and template commands. It is not taken from the model's description.
- Unknown, expired and p"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"re-rescan cleanup ids are denied without asking. A cleanup id can be executed at most once.
- Cancel"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ling a running call stops the core process; the next call starts a new one, and `pare_scan` must be "},{"id":"p18s5","text":"ning call stops the core process; the next call starts a new one, and `pare_scan` must be run again."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The core enforces its own checks, independent of the host:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- Protected locations are always refused.
- Every item carries evidence produced by `BuildSelected`."},{"id":"p20s2","text":"
- Before each file is moved, the executor re-checks its identity, whether it changed, and whether i"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"t is in use.
- Action templates are validated, the preview digest must match, and a preview expires "},{"id":"p20s4","text":"after 30 minutes.
- The preview is marked as used before execution starts.
- `undo` and `purge` acce"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"pt only manifests inside the Pare quarantine."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Privacy: investigation tools return paths and file names to the model (and its provider). The conten"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ts of sensitive files require your approval on every read."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## The pinned core"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The `pareCore` entry in `package.json` pins the core for this plugin version: version 0.4.0, the dow"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"nload URL (the `pare-0.4.0-win-x64.exe` asset of the `v0.4.0` release of `DRAG0NM/Pare`) and its SHA"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"-256, `23a09ed98b24642e80c1ee83d8a7464e6fa0df2ac1a1d6e078cd5882672001fb`."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"When neither `parePath` nor `PARE_CORE_PATH` is set:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- The plugin uses `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Pare\core\pare-0.4.0.exe`, stored per user outside the plugin dire"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ctory so reinstalling or upgrading the plugin does not lose it. If the file is missing, it is downlo"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"aded from the pinned URL: first with `curl.exe` from System32 (which honors `HTTPS_PROXY`), then, if"},{"id":"p25s4","text":" that fails, with PowerShell's `Invoke-WebRequest` (which uses the Windows system proxy).
- The SHA-"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"256 is verified after the download. The file is kept only if it matches; a mismatching download is d"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"eleted.
- The hash is verified again on every start and before every core process start. If the file"},{"id":"p25s7","text":" has been modified, the plugin refuses to run (it never replaces it automatically) and the error say"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"s to delete the file so it is downloaded again.
- The version reported by `hello` must equal the pin"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"ned version; otherwise the plugin refuses it and registers no investigation tools.
- On some machine"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"s `AppData\Local` is EFS-encrypted and a rename within the directory is rejected (EXDEV), or an anti"},{"id":"p25s11","text":"virus briefly holds the file. The plugin retries for a few seconds, then falls back to copying and d"},{"id":"p25s12","text":"eleting the temporary file; the final file must pass the same hash check."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"For development, point `parePath` (plugin option) or the `PARE_CORE_PATH` environment variable at yo"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ur own `pare.exe` (`go build -o pare.exe ./cmd/pare`). No hash check is done then; only the protocol"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" (`go build -o pare.exe ./cmd/pare`). No hash check is done then; only the protocol name is checked."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- Windows.
- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` (Cordis `4.0.5`). Harness is still a developer preview an"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"d its interfaces may change incompatibly; Pare-DSH pins the peer version to the tool interface it wa"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"s verified against, so re-test before upgrading.
- Node.js 22.19 or newer (DSH's own requirement).
-"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" Access to GitHub on first start, to download the pinned core."}],"truncated":true}
